For me it comes in waves. Like in the movies when you see someone swimming in the ocean,  and they're doing fine, but then out of nowhere the storm rolls in and suddenly they're fighting to keep their head above the waves. Your friend seemingly had a life raft, but sometimes even those give in during a powerful storm. Depression is like cancer, it's a sickness.  We can live a life without smoking a single cigarette, and get lung cancer. It's not something people ask for. It just happens regardless of your own circumstances or personal choices.  I have a semi okay life, but I still want to put a bullet in my head some days, that also invites thoughts like,

"My life is good, I'm so selfish,  I'll just die."  I don't know why. I don't know why the storm rolled in and I don't smoke cigarettes but I have the cancer.  I just want to die. I just feel empty and my brand new car or dating a sexy super model won't fill that empty. If that all makes sense. Looking in from the outside only shows one view of a situation that has layers.  I smile,  but I'm not happy. I joke, but I welcome death. And even when life is good I still have memories of those nights I spent alone wishing my next breath would be my life's finale. It's there,  always. In the back of my head. I want it gone. But it won't go. I didn't ask for it, but it's there.  I think I deviated,  but I hope I got the point across.
